signature_verification.registration_rule: The signer identity and public key must be fixed in the independently timestamped preregistration package before any formal Provider call. A test key, agent-generated key, mutable environment variable, or key supplied inside a run receipt is not trusted authority.
signature_verification.signed_payload_schema: easyicu.figure2_atomic_declaration/3; site_assignment_sha256 and the exact output_root_by_site mapping are mandatory, and every qualification/core coordinate and trajectory lease must match that registered assignment and site output root
signature_verification.receipt_payload_schema: easyicu.figure2_launch_receipt/1; every required receipt must have status=passed, a release binding, evidence digest, issuer, and UTC issue time; the external registration receipt must additionally satisfy every preregistration required_receipt_field and bind the same signer key
signature_verification.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, and NaN forbidden

authorization_scopes.qualification12: Requires every qualification_preconditions receipt and authorizes only the named Qualification12 set. It grants no core or paper authority. After the set is opened, any qualification-relevant change to either arm's harness, prompt, tool contract, release or gates, or to the shared normalizer, evaluator, model route, or numeric budgets consumes the used set and requires the next unopened preregistered reserve set.
authorization_scopes.core_wp2_wp3: Requires every design, data, evaluation, qualification, runtime, and batch receipt.
authorization_scopes.wp5_phase_a: Requires the frozen core release, all core terminal receipts, and every wp5_phase_a receipt. It permits bounded iterative Provider calls over the sealed direction, declared literature, nonpatient metadata, and neutral deterministic-feasibility receipts, but cannot access patient rows or patient-level outcome results.
authorization_scopes.wp5_phase_b_showcase: Requires the same frozen release plus every wp5_phase_b_showcase receipt. It authorizes only the locked flagship input and forbids postoutcome substitution, selective retry, or product repair.

authorization_rule: A Provider call is authorized only within one explicitly requested scope when every receipt for that scope is present, valid, mutually consistent, bound to the same clean release, protocol digest, and site-assignment digest, and the Ed25519-verified atomic declaration from the preregistered signer names that exact task, arm, execution site, call coordinate, and output root by site. Qualification and core declarations must include both arms of every assigned task, and each trajectory lease must match the registered task, site, pair, sequence, and exact site output root.
failure_rule: Missing, stale, mismatched, unverifiable, or partially passing evidence returns a typed denial. No warning-only or partial-database launch exists.

current_authority.reason: This repository contains only a review candidate: no trusted external signer key is registered and no external registration, input, qualification, evaluator, runtime, or atomic-batch receipts exist.
